question.text: The PRIMARY disadvantage of cash-flow matching vs immunization is:

answer.text: Higher cost due to limited eligible bonds

explanation.text: The Logic: Cash-flow matching requires specific maturity matches — often fewer eligible bonds meet the constraints, leading to higher cost (tighter spreads). Immunization is flexible (any duration match works). The Trap: Returns/duration/credit aren't the key trade-off — flexibility vs precision is. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B-specific insight. Manager's Pro-Tip: Immunization is more cost-efficient but demands monitoring; cash-flow matching is set-and-forget but expensive to construct.
